rules: Transport readiness is evidence, never authorization.
Facts and reader-appropriate text readiness are mandatory for every external Gmail send.
Routine owner brief and known-thread reply need no extra owner approval when no restricted trigger is present.
Approved static copy may skip the rewrite pipeline only when exact text identity and current facts are proven.
New commercial commitment or price/spend requires exact owner approval bound to the exact body before ALLOW.
Bulk/blast behavior and unverified facts are denied.
Provider send receipt remains required before claiming sent.
